// diagnostic

E3212

`{abi}` is not a known C calling convention.

What

`{abi}` is not a known C calling convention.

Why

`#ABI` accepts only the ratified native ABI names — `#ABI` also never applies to `extern rust` (Rust FFI keeps its own declared ABI).

Fix

use `system`, `cdecl`, `stdcall`, `fastcall`, `win64`, or `sysv64`, or remove `#ABI` from the `extern rust` function.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3212: tests/ui/cffi_abi_unknown.stderr.

Error [E3212]: `vectorcall` is not a known C calling convention
  --> tests/ui/cffi_abi_unknown.jet:4:10
    |
  4 |     #ABI(vectorcall) fn ping(x: I32) I32 = "ping"
    |          ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `#ABI` accepts only the ratified native ABI names
 Fix: use `system`, `cdecl`, `stdcall`, `fastcall`, `win64`, or `sysv64`
